headline_en: Fed rate hike and 10Y yield at 5% pressure growth multiples across tech
executive_bullets_en: Fed implemented rate hike on sticky inflation; 10Y Treasury yield topped 5% for second time in 20 years, pressuring equities via higher discount rates
MU (UPTREND) strongest last-session gainer at +3.92% with Stage2 5/7 and RS 12.6; NVDA (UPTREND) and PLTR (UPTREND) also advanced while META (DISTRIBUTION) fell 2.43%
Risk regime CONSTRUCTIVE at 65.7/100 with VIX improving but breadth and rates signaling caution; SPY distribution days at 10 (DANGER)
executive_bullets_ko: Fed 금리인상 확인·10년물 5% 돌파로 성장주 밸류에이션 압력
MU (UPTREND) +3.92%로 가장 강한 상승, NVDA·PLTR도 상승했으나 META (DISTRIBUTION)는 -2.43%
리스크 레짐 CONSTRUCTIVE 65.7점이지만 브레드스·금리 신호는 주의 필요, SPY 분배일 10일

market_mood.explanation_en: The 65.7 regime score sits in the constructive zone, like a river that is flowing but with visible rocks ahead. It suggests selective buying is reasonable today but position sizes should stay modest because breadth and rates are still flashing red.
market_mood.explanation_ko: 65.7점은 건설적 구간에 해당해 강물이 흐르지만 바위가 보이는 상황과 비슷합니다. 선택적 매수는 가능하지만 브레드스와 금리 신호가 빨간불이므로 비중은 작게 유지하는 것이 안전합니다.

big_picture.summary_en: Federal Reserve implemented a rate hike reflecting persistent inflation and stronger growth; 10-year Treasury yield topped 5% for the second time in nearly 20 years. Equities face immediate re-pricing on inflation persistence with NVDA, MSFT and AMZN all marked negative impact.
big_picture.summary_ko: Fed가 끈끈한 인플레이션과 강한 성장 반영해 금리인상을 단행했고 10년물 국채수익률이 20년 만에 두 번째로 5%를 넘었습니다. 인플레이션 지속으로 주식 밸류에이션 즉각 재조정이 예상되며 NVDA·MSFT·AMZN 모두 부정적 영향으로 표시됐습니다.
big_picture.vix_note_en: VIX sits at 14.81, down 4.08% today. This level signals calm rather than fear, but the improving reading can flip quickly if rate-sensitive growth names extend their losses.
big_picture.vix_note_ko: VIX가 14.81로 오늘 4.08% 하락했습니다. 이는 공포보다는 안정 신호지만 금리에 민감한 성장주들이 추가 하락하면 빠르게 반전될 수 있습니다.
big_picture.rates_note_en: 10-year yield is at 5.00%, up 1.03% today. Higher yields increase discount rates on future earnings and directly pressure high-valuation growth stocks.
big_picture.rates_note_ko: 10년물 국채수익률이 5.00%로 오늘 1.03% 상승했습니다. 높은 금리는 미래 이익의 할인율을 높여 고평가 성장주에 직접적인 압력으로 작용합니다.
big_picture.dollar_note_en: The dollar index (DXY) is at 100.22. A stable dollar at this level offers little relief for multinational tech earnings and keeps overseas revenue translation neutral.
big_picture.dollar_note_ko: 달러지수(DXY)가 100.22로 유지되고 있습니다. 이 수준의 안정적 달러는 다국적 기술 기업 실적에 큰 도움도 부담도 주지 않으며 해외 매출 환산은 중립적입니다.
big_picture.btc_note_en: Bitcoin is at $80,775.07, down 0.56% today and 6.83% over five days. This modest pullback signals slightly reduced risk appetite but remains far from panic levels.

sector_analysis.leaders_en: Commodities and volatility groups showing green signals with GLD (ACCUMULATION) and BTC-USD (ACCUMULATION) leading; SMH (ACCUMULATION) also positive on semiconductor strength.

sector_analysis.laggards_en: Rates and credit groups remain red with ^TNX (DISTRIBUTION) and HYG (UPTREND) under pressure; breadth also weak as RSP (UPTREND) and IWM (DOWNTREND) both declined.

sector_analysis.rotation_signal_en: Money appears to be rotating toward commodities and away from rate-sensitive growth names as higher yields compress multiples; defensive rotation into gold and bitcoin is visible.
